title: Tier-scaled placement ghost (draw_place_ghost) has zero test coverage
detail: The tier-scaled ghost preview is new render behaviour, but the harness always captures with an inactive drag ({}), so no golden or unit test exercises it. A wrong scale or guard would ship unseen.
recommended_fix: Add a harness capture with an active placement drag (per tier), or a unit test pinning router_tier_scale values 1.0/1.15/1.30.

title: No automated coverage for tray router chips or their type_idx arming (acceptance #1)
detail: The diff's catalog rows auto-populate the tray (acceptance #1: three router chips), yet no test or golden renders the tray or verifies a chip arms the correct type_idx — the lens-guard defect class.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test for tray_router_types ordering and type_idx mapping, or a harness T2 capture that draws the 6-chip tray.

title: max(1,sep) zero-separation clamp in placement_valid is untested
detail: The documented 'never a silent zero-separation' clamp never executes in any test: every fixture sets Placement_Balance explicitly, so the zero-value Balance literal branch has no pin.
recommended_fix: Add a placement test with a zero-value Placement_Balance: an adjacent placement must reject via the clamp-to-1 path.

title: draw_nodes type-index bounds guard (continue) is untested
detail: New defensive guard skips junctions whose type index outruns the catalog; no harness scenario or test produces such a topology, so the branch has zero coverage. Low risk, unpinned.
recommended_fix: Accept as documented defensive code, or add a direct render test feeding an out-of-range node_type index.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100% (catalog ladder + placement-block negatives, kind-split boundaries, mid/high ceilings, placement, replay — FULL). P1 ≥90% (tier visuals FULL via 4 new T2 captures; ghost + tray uncovered, P2). Overall ≥80% → PASS.
recommended_fix: Add a harness drag-state capture for the tier-scaled placement ghost and a tray chip-arming test to close the two P2 gaps.
